name: website-starter
title: Website Starter
description: A minimal marketing website: a `page` document type (hero + body) a Next.js site renders. The bare scaffold to start a brand-new site from.

env.description: Barkpark API base the site fetches from (server-side, scoped).
Read-only, workspace-bound token minted at bootstrap. Server-only.

Shared HMAC secret for ISR cache revalidation: the instance's webhook dispatcher signs with it and the site's /api/barkpark/webhook handler verifies with it. Generated at bootstrap and bound to a disabled webhook endpoint whose URL is wired once the site deploys. Server-only.
